Select compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Start from molecule_dictionary for CHEMBL941 as parent. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to include parent and all child salts. Join compound_records on molregno, then docs on doc_id, then activities on record_id. Join assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and target chembl_id CHEMBL1936. Derive pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id over doi from docs. Alias molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, target_dictionary.organism as target_organism, assays.description as assay_description. Sort by all output columns ascending. No row limit.
